```sql
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    d.month_name,
    d.year_month,
    SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue
  FROM fact_orders o
  JOIN dim_date d ON o.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND d.date <= DATE '2018-08-31'
  GROUP BY d.month_name, d.year_month
  ORDER BY d.year_month
)
SELECT
  month_name,
  ROUND(
    (
      (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) /
      NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) AS month_over_month_growth_pct
FROM monthly_revenue;
```

```sql
WITH seller_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ds.seller_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered THEN fo.order_id END) AS delivered_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered AND NOT fo.is_late THEN fo.order_id END) AS on_time_orders
  FROM dim_seller ds
  JOIN fact_order_items foi ON ds.seller_key = foi.seller_key
  JOIN fact_orders fo ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id
  GROUP BY ds.seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered THEN fo.order_id END) >= 100
)
SELECT
  seller_id,
  delivered_orders,
  ROUND(on_time_orders * 100.0 / NULLIF(delivered_orders, 0), 2) AS on_time_rate_pct
FROM seller_stats
ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,
    d.month,
    d.year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(f.is_late) AS late_orders
  FROM fact_orders f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE (d.year = 2017 AND d.month >= 1) OR (d.year = 2018 AND d.month <= 8)
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.year_month
),
monthly_rate AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    (late_orders * 100.0 / total_orders) AS late_rate_pct
  FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT
  year_month,
  late_rate_pct
FROM monthly_rate
WHERE late_rate_pct = (SELECT MAX(late_rate_pct) FROM monthly_rate);
```

```sql
),
ranked AS (
```

```sql
WITH revenue_per_seller AS (
    SELECT
        seller_key,
        SUM(order_value) AS seller_revenue
    FROM
        fact_orders
    GROUP BY
        seller_key
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(seller_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM
        revenue_per_seller
),
cumulative_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        seller_key,
        seller_revenue,
        SUM(seller_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY seller_revenue DESC) AS cumulative_revenue,
        total_revenue.total_revenue
    FROM
        revenue_per_seller
    CROSS JOIN
        total_revenue
)
SELECT
    MIN(seller_key) AS min_seller_key,
```

```sql
WITH revenue_aug_2017 AS (

    JOIN dim_date ON fact_orders.purchase_date_key = dim_date.date_key

    JOIN dim_date ON fact_orders.purchase_date_key = dim_date.date_key
    WHERE dim_date.year = 2018 AND dim_date.month = 8
```

```sql
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        p.category_en,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_delivered_orders
    FROM
        fact_orders o
    JOIN
        dim_product p ON o.product_key = p.product_key
    WHERE
        o.is_delivered = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        p.category_en
    HAVING
        COUNT(o.order_id) >= 500
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT
        p.category_en,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM
        fact_orders o
    JOIN
        dim_product p ON o.product_key = p.product_key
    WHERE
        o.is_delivered = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        p.category_en
),
on_time_rate AS (
    SELECT
        d.category_en,
        (d.total_delivered_orders * 100.0 / t.total_orders) AS on_time_rate
    FROM
        delivered_orders d
    JOIN
        total_orders t ON d.category_en = t.category_en
)
SELECT
    category_en,
    on_time_rate
FROM
    on_time_rate
ORDER BY
    on_time_rate ASC
LIMIT 2;
```

```sql
        COUNT(fact_orders.order_id) AS total_on_time_orders

    JOIN
```

```sql
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    dim_date.year_month,
    SUM(fact_orders.order_value) AS revenue
  FROM
    fact_orders
  JOIN
    dim_date ON fact_orders.purchase_date_key = dim_date.date_key
  WHERE
    dim_date.year = 2018
    AND dim_date.month BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY
    dim_date.year_month
)
SELECT
  year_month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_revenue,
  ((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) * 100 AS month_over_month_growth
FROM
  monthly_revenue
ORDER BY
  year_month;
```

```sql
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        seller_key,
        COUNT(order_id) AS delivered_count
    FROM
        fact_orders
    WHERE
        order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY
        seller_key
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT
        seller_key,
        COUNT(order_id) AS total_count
    FROM
        fact_orders
    WHERE
        order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY
        seller_key
),
on_time_orders AS (
    SELECT
        seller_key,
        COUNT(order_id) AS on_time_count
    FROM
        fact_orders
    WHERE
        order_status = 'delivered' AND is_late = FALSE
    GROUP BY
        seller_key
),
seller_details AS (
    SELECT
        s.seller_id,
        s.state,
        s.lat,
        s.lng
    FROM
        dim_seller s
)
SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    d.delivered_count,
    ROUND((o.on_time_count * 100.0 / d.delivered_count), 2) AS on_time_rate
FROM
    seller_details s
JOIN
    delivered_orders d ON s.seller_key = d.seller_key
JOIN
    on_time_orders o ON s.seller_key = o.seller_key
WHERE
    d.delivered_count >= 100
ORDER BY
    on_time_rate ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
WITH category_revenue AS (

),

    FROM
        category_revenue
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT
        category_en,
        category_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY category_revenue DESC) AS rank
    FROM
        category_revenue
)

    SUM(category_revenue) * 100 / tr.total_category_revenue AS top_10_category_share
FROM
    top_categories tc
JOIN
    total_revenue tr ON 1=1
WHERE
    rank <= 10;
```

```sql
WITH revenue_by_seller AS (
    SELECT
        dim_seller.seller_id,
        SUM(fact_order_items.price) AS seller_revenue
    FROM
        fact_order_items
    JOIN
        dim_seller ON fact_order_items.seller_key = dim_seller.seller_key
    GROUP BY
        dim_seller.seller_id
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(seller_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM
        revenue_by_seller
),
cumulative_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        seller_revenue,
        SUM(seller_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY seller_revenue DESC) AS cumulative_revenue,
        total_revenue.total_revenue
    FROM
        revenue_by_seller
    CROSS JOIN
        total_revenue
)
SELECT
    MIN(seller_id) AS min_seller_id,
    COUNT(seller_id) AS num_sellers
FROM
    cumulative_revenue
WHERE
    cumulative_revenue >= 0.8 * total_revenue;
```
